name: Self-advancing goals
principle: Goals keep moving between a person's sessions, because the work they delegated gets done to the standard they wrote.
state_description: You schedule an AI task the way you schedule a goal, and at that time it happens: grounded, finished to its written standard, reported against the goal, with your attention asked for only where it is needed.
hints_of_measurement: Delegated tasks finish to their written standard without rework.

name: Trusted autonomy
principle: The AI acts first on what it may decide and brings the person exactly the decisions that are theirs.
state_description: Work moves without you, and when a question reaches you it is one only you should answer, with what you need to answer it.
hints_of_measurement: No human-only step is taken alone, and few asks turn out to be unnecessary.

name: One shared engine
principle: One domain-free engine serves every consumer, every lane and both chat and scheduled work, and differs only in configuration.
state_description: A new product or team gets grounded, escalating AI help by supplying configuration and adapters, and every improvement reaches everyone who uses it.
hints_of_measurement: Consumers add little glue of their own and copy none of the engine.
